destinations.name: Mount Gambier
destinations.coordinates_source: wikipedia:Mount Gambier (centre of town; candidate point)

name_evidence.wording: Mount Gambier: the region city with its crater lakes and sinkholes; Wikivoyage lists Ewens/Piccaninnie Ponds and Port MacDonnell around it

destinations.notes: Town candidate Mount Gambier is the destination, not a spot (its draws are the lakes and sinkholes). Port MacDonnell kept town folded into Cape Northumberland and the Maritime Museum (no wrapper).

spots_detail.name: Blue Lake
spots_detail.bio: A volcanic crater lake in Mount Gambier that turns a vivid blue each summer, with a lookout and a walking track around the rim.
spots_detail.reason: Kept; inside the destination span and reached from its base.

spots_detail.name: Cave Garden

destinations.name: Naracoorte

name_evidence.source: en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Naracoorte; Wikivoyage Limestone Coast region page
name_evidence.wording: Naracoorte: town with its own page, base for Naracoorte Caves (UNESCO World Heritage)

destinations.notes: Penola and Coonawarra are 40-50 km north and are reached from Naracoorte or from Penola; included so the destination reaches 5 spots; Penola town is a wrapper for the Mary MacKillop Penola Centre. Naracoorte Caves National Park is a spot, not its own destination, because its other candidates (Victoria Fossil Cave) went to review; the owner may promote the park if Victoria Fossil Cave is kept.

review.name: Old Mount Gambier Gaol
review.reason: For: 1866-1995 gaol, self-guided and guided tours of crimes and cell life, Wikivoyage lists it (under Sleep) and it hosts gigs. Against: operates chiefly as accommodation/function venue; no See entry in a counted source (southaustralia.com and discovermountgambier URLs 404/unfound).

review.name: Victoria Fossil Cave
review.reason: For: the headline Naracoorte tour cave, World Heritage fossil site with its own ticketed tour (naracoortecaves.sa.gov.au). Against: part of Naracoorte Caves National Park, so a near-duplicate of the park spot if that is listed.
